description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Web Technologies topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: web-technologies

facts.claim: The Web was invented by Tim Berners-Lee at CERN (1989)

source.quote: The Web was invented by English computer scientist Tim Berners-Lee while at CERN in 1989

facts.claim: Pages in HTML, fetched with HTTP by browsers

source.quote: It facilitates access to documents and other web resources according to specific rules of the Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP)

facts.claim: HTTP is a request–response protocol (client–server)

source.quote: HTTP is a request–response protocol in the client–server model

facts.claim: HTTP is stateless

source.quote: HTTP is a stateless application-level protocol

facts.claim: HTML is the markup language for web pages

source.quote: Hypertext Markup Language (HTML) is the standard markup language for documents designed to be displayed in a web browser

facts.claim: Elements are delimited by tags in angle brackets

source.quote: HTML elements are delineated by tags, written using angle brackets

facts.claim: CSS separates presentation from content

source.quote: CSS is designed to enable the separation of content and presentation

facts.claim: The cascade decides which rule wins

source.quote: The name cascading comes from the specified priority scheme to determine which declaration applies

facts.claim: XML is both human-readable and machine-readable

source.quote: a format that is both human-readable and machine-readable

facts.claim: XML stores and transports data

source.quote: a markup language and file format for storing, transmitting, and reconstructing data

facts.claim: The DOM treats a document as a tree of nodes

source.quote: treats an HTML or XML document as a tree structure wherein each node is an object

facts.claim: DOM methods change structure, style and content

source.quote: with them one can change the structure, style or content of a document

facts.claim: JavaScript is a core web technology with HTML and CSS

source.quote: JavaScript (JS) is a programming language and core technology of the Web, alongside HTML and CSS

facts.claim: Ajax fetches data asynchronously without reloading the page

source.quote: web applications can send and retrieve data from a server asynchronously (in the background) without interfering with the display

facts.claim: A cookie is a small piece of data from the server stored by the browser

source.quote: a small block of data created by a web server while a user is browsing a website

facts.claim: Cookies let servers keep state (e.g. a shopping cart)

source.quote: They enable web servers to store stateful information (such as items added in the shopping cart

facts.claim: A URL locates a resource and how to fetch it

source.quote: A URL specifies the location of a resource on a computer network and a mechanism for retrieving it

facts.claim: Protocol, hostname and path

source.quote: indicates protocol https, hostname www.example.com, and file name index.html

facts.claim: JDBC is the Java API for accessing databases

source.quote: is an application programming interface (API) for the Java programming language which defines how a client may access a database

facts.claim: A servlet is Java code that extends a server to answer requests

source.quote: is a Java software component that extends the capabilities of a server

facts.claim: Most often used with HTTP

source.quote: Servlets could in principle communicate over any client–server protocol, but they are most often used with HTTP
